# Berkeley Wellbeing

> > Science-based mental health and positive psychology resources founded by Tchiki Davis, offering evidence-based articles, PLR content for wellness professionals, and practical tools for emotional wellbeing.

Berkeley Wellbeing provides research-backed psychology education covering topics from emotion regulation to attachment theory, alongside Private Label Rights (PLR) content packages that wellness businesses can license. The site bridges academic psychology (citing APA and DSM-5) with accessible self-help resources including workbooks, journals, and guided practices.

## Key Topics

- Tchiki Davis
- Mental Health
- Emotion Regulation
- Positive Psychology
- Private Label Rights (PLR)
- Psychology Definitions
- Emotional Wellbeing
- Self-Esteem
- Relationship Psychology
- Negative Emotions
- American Psychological Association (APA)
- Rejection Tolerance
- Well-Being
- Wellness Business Growth

## Private Label Rights (PLR) Content

- [Private Label Rights (PLR): Content, Courses, & Articles](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/plr.html): Overview of PLR content licensing for wellness business growth
- [Other PLR Well-Being Content](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/plr-wellbeing-content-other.html): Science-based PLR content packages including ebooks and worksheets

## Emotion Regulation & Mental Health

- [Emotional Dysregulation: Definition, Examples, And Tips](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/emotional-dysregulation.html): APA definition and healthy emotion regulation tips by Sperber
- [Tolerate Feeling Rejected](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/tolerate-feeling-rejected.html): Guide to rejection tolerance and emotional processing by Tchiki Davis
- [Mood Disorders: Definitions, Symptoms, & List](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/mood-disorders.html): DSM-5 mood disorders including depression and bipolar symptoms
- [Neuroticism: Definition, Causes, and Examples](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/neuroticism.html): Psychological trait of negative emotions explored by Charlie Huntington
- [Tension Release Music: How Sound Helps Reduce Body Stress](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/tension-release-music.html): Sound therapy and music relaxation for nervous system regulation

## Psychology Foundations & Theories

- [Personality Psychology: Definition, Examples, & Theories](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/personality-psychology.html): Personality theories, tests, and individual differences by Birenbaum
- [Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs: Definition, Examples & Explanation](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/maslows-hierarchy-of-needs.html): Abraham Maslow's human motivation theory explained with examples
- [Conditioning: Definition, Types, & Psychology](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/conditioning.html): Classical and operant conditioning in behavioral psychology (APA)
- [Delayed Gratification: Definition, Examples, & Quotes](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/delayed-gratification.html): Self-control, willpower, and behavior change psychology by Yilmaz

## Relationships & Attachment

- [Secure Attachment: Definition, Examples, & Theory](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/secure-attachment.html): Bowlby's attachment theory and developing secure relationships
- [Kissing: Definition, Types, & Tips](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/kissing.html): Psychological research on intimacy and romantic relationship connections

## Personal Development & Wellbeing Practices

- [Self-Confidence: Definition, Affirmations, and Tips for Gaining Confidence](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/self-confidence.html): Science-based confidence building strategies and affirmations by Davis
- [Morning Meditation: What It Is & How to Do It](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/morning-meditation.html): Beginner guide to morning meditation benefits and daily practice
- [Leadership Skills: Definition, Examples, & Development](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/leadership-skills.html): Team motivation and professional leadership development strategies
- [Dreams: Definition, Research, & Interpretations](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/dreams.html): Sleep consciousness, dream research, and interpretation psychology

## Optional

- [Selfishness: Definition, Opposite, & Human Nature](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/selfishness.html): Exploring selfishness as natural human behavior by Charlie Huntington
- [Hope Quotes: For Love, Strength, & Inspiration](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/hope-quotes.html): Inspirational hope quotes collection by Kelsey Schultz
- [Happiness Articles Pg S](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/happiness-articles-pg-s.html): Archive page for happiness and positive psychology article collection
